name: Takehara (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Takehara city emblem in green: a stylised three-pointed device of leaves, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Takehara, a city in Hiroshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 30 September 1963.

features.role: Takehara city emblem — a stylised three-pointed device of leaves, like a stylised character
